info.name: 40 Reviews
info.description: Hotel review feature (R1 to R5). B1: Review model rules and hotel averageRating/reviewCount. B4: public GET /hotels/:hotelId/reviews. B2: POST /bookings/:bookingId/reviews. B3: GET /reviews (own, admin all), GET /reviews/:id, PUT and DELETE /reviews/:id (owner). B5: admin DELETE /reviews/:id (R5); deleting a booking deletes its review and deleting a hotel deletes its reviews, with averages kept correct; averageRating and reviewCount cannot be set through the hotel endpoints.

exec: pm.test('newest first', () => { for (let i = 1; i < body.data.length; i++) { pm.expect(new Date(body.data[i - 1].createdAt).getTime()).to.be.at.least(new Date(body.data[i].createdAt).getTime()); } });
pm.test('reviewer shows name only', () => body.data.forEach((r) => { pm.expect(r.user.name).to.eql('Test User One'); pm.expect(Object.keys(r.user).sort()).to.eql(['_id', 'name']); }));
pm.test('review has rating, comment, booking, createdAt', () => pm.expect(body.data[0]).to.include.keys('rating', 'comment', 'booking', 'createdAt'));
pm.test('averageRating and count match the hotel', () => { pm.expect(body.averageRating).to.eql(stats.averageRating); pm.expect(body.count).to.eql(stats.reviewCount); });
